name: Webster State Park (Rock Point)
note: Rock Point campground of Webster State Park (KDWP), one gravel loop on a knoll beside the boat ramp at the east end of the north shore, entered just inside the park where 10 Road comes south from US-24. The park's other north-shore campgrounds (Lake View and the west cluster) are their own entry. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: campitks.gov (2026-11-06): the 'Rock Point' loop (510316) on parkID 519133 holds 10 campsites, 078-087, all 'Standard with Water and Electric Hookups' 50/30/20 A, site-specific reservable, 'Looking For Category: RV Site,Tent Site,Trailer Site', gravel (087 concrete), 'Maximum Vehicle Length' 40-125 ft, 082 pull-through; the loop's other nine listings are a shelter (#14) and eight 'Primitive Site' rows that are day-use shoreline shelters #806-813 ('Looking For Category: Day Use'), not campsites. A separate place from 2087: its access road leaves the park drive ~150 m inside the east entry at the end of public 10 Road (OSM + Esri imagery 2026-11-06), 1.08 km from the nearest Lake View pad and 2.3-2.7 km from the west cluster's loops, which are entered from 9 Road. Public campground, no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery 2026-11-06, 500 m frame with all campitks site coordinates plotted: the 10 pads sit inside the campground's own loop road on a knoll with scattered trees; outside the loop the ground falls to the drawn-down lake bed on the NE and to the boat-ramp parking lot on the SE. 3DEP (USGS EPQS) puts the pads at 578.2-579.7 m against Reclamation's top of conservation pool 1892.45 ft (576.8 m) and 572.0 m on the water at lidar time; the full-pool contour (575.6 m at 39.4168,-99.4310) lies ~60-90 m out, beyond the loop road -> loop road and ramp lot in the way, not lakefront. Open view over the lake on two sides and campitks 'River/Lake View: Y' on all 10 ('Proximity to Water: Within 1/4 Mile') -> lakeview. Not below the dam: Webster Dam is ~1 km SE and the pads are ~2 m above pool on the reservoir side.

fees.note: KDWP's statewide schedule from November 1, 2026: a daily camping permit of $17.75 a night per camping unit, plus $13 a night for two utilities (water and electric), so every Rock Point site costs $30.75 a night. All 10 are designated prime sites, which adds $2 a night on stays April-September ($32.75). A $2.75 processing fee per stay and a vehicle permit ($7 a day) are charged on top. Water and electric shows as electric +$11 plus water +$2. Read 2026-10-15.

fees_source: https://ksoutdoors.gov/licenses-permits-fees/kansas-state-park-entrance-and-camping-fees (as quoted on sibling 2087, read 2026-10-15: 'Daily Camping Permit ... $12.75 per night $17.75 per night'; 'Utility Fees ... $11.00 per night for one utility $13.00 per night for two utilities'; 'Prime Site Fee ... designated sites on stays April 1-September 30 ... $2.00 per night'; 'a $2.75 processing fee will apply to each camping stay'; 'Daily Vehicle Permit ... $5.00 $7.00'); fee shape copied from 2087 (verified p3-308). campitks campsiteDetails for 078-087: 'Number of Utilities: 2', 'Prime Site: Y', read 2026-11-06.

min_stay.season: Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends (2027 rule)

booking.note: Sites are reserved site by site on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov); the reservation window shown on 2026-11-06 ran from Nov 8, 2026 to Dec 6, 2027. Self-registration on arrival is also allowed. 2027 holiday minimum: 3 nights over Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends. Up to 14 consecutive nights in one campground, then move to another campground in the park.

booking_source: https://www.campitks.gov/camping/webster-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=519133 (park-wide '2027 CAMPSITES Holiday Minimum Stay Rule' 3 nights Memorial Day / Independence Day / Labor Day, '14 days maximum consecutive stay rule', 'Open year round.', as recorded on 2087 2026-11-06) and campsiteDetails.page?parkID=519133&siteID=<id> ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific', 'Self Reg Allowed: Y', 'Reservation Window: Sun Nov 08 2026 - Mon Dec 06 2027'), re-read live 2026-11-06 for siteID 3450, 3455, 3457, 3462

The lead's '+ 8 primitive' at Rock Point are not campsites: campitks rows 'Shelter #806' to 'Shelter #813' are typed 'Primitive Site' but 'Looking For Category: Day Use', strung along the shore 0.3-1 km WEST of the Rock Point loop (39.4123-39.4151, -99.4399 to -99.4326). Not counted.

Access (OSM ways + Esri World Imagery, 2026-11-06): the north shore is one connected park-road system. Public 9 Road comes south from US-24 into the west cluster (Hill Top, Old Marina, Eagle Landing = 2087); an unnamed paved park drive (OSM way 13224958, no street name in Esri's address data) leaves 9 Road at the L Road corner and runs ~2.2 km NE along the shore, past Lake View's spur, to the park's east entry at the end of public 10 Road (the park office is 1140 Ten Rd).
